content: It is interesting to see from Table TABREF26 that our augmentation method consistently outperforms the weighting method, showing that data augmentation can be a more suitable technique than data weighting for manipulating small-size data. Our approach provides the generality to instantiate diverse manipulation types and learn with the same single procedure.
